Tala · Guard and three-punch combo

A recorded normal-speed video of the Design 02 study. It plays without loading the interactive 3D preview.

Guard and block: 0–2.4 seconds. Combo: 2.4–4 seconds. The sequence repeats when looping is enabled.

This is a rendered video using the game’s animation poses, not a recording of live gameplay. Materials and lighting differ from the game. The playable model has newer art revisions; this recording preserves the earlier study. Shoulders, hair and shoes are still being refined.
